mines.mine_notes: Barsele gold project, northern Sweden; 45% joint-venture ownership with Agnico Eagle Mines (55%). Resource-stage: indicated 5.58 Mt @ 1.81 g/t Au = 324 koz (146 koz attributable); inferred 25.50 Mt @ 2.54 g/t Au = 2.09 Moz (0.94 Moz attributable). Gold Line Belt projects (~100 km of strike) surround Barsele to the north and south. No production.

100%-owned Rajapalot gold-cobalt project, northern Finland (Rompas-Rajapalot property). Inferred resource: 9.8 Mt @ 2.8 g/t Au and 441 ppm Co = 0.9 Moz Au / 4,311 t Co. Supported by a 2023 PEA (robust economics; cobalt byproduct exposure). No production.

100%-owned Oijärvi project, northern Finland. Indicated: 1.07 Mt @ 4.1 g/t Au and 35.4 g/t Ag (143 koz Au + 1,220 koz Ag = 159 koz AuEq); inferred: 1.63 Mt @ 2.7 g/t Au and 15.2 g/t Ag (142 koz Au + 795 koz Ag = 152 koz AuEq). No production.

notes: Nordic gold developer/explorer; no FY2025 production or revenue. Created December 2025 by merger of First Nordic Metals Corp. (TSX-V:FNM) and Mawson Finland Limited (TSX-V:MFL); renamed Goldsky Resources; accompanied by C$80M equity raise. Combined land position >123,000 ha across Sweden and Finland; combined attributable resources ~2.0 Moz AuEq inferred + ~0.3 Moz AuEq indicated. CEO Russell Bradford; incoming chairman Peter Breese. Ticker GSKR pending confirmation.
